Commentary: Jasprit Bumrah to Daryl Mitchell, out Caught by Yashasvi Jaiswal!! Sharp catch at forward short-leg and Jaiswal is thrilled as Gill hugs him. Daryl Mitchell was batting well outside his crease and was walking at Jasprit Bumrah. He does the same to this good length nipbacker, on off and middle. The thick inside edge on the forward defence hits the thigh pad and lobs to Jaiswal who's quite deep at forward short-leg. Taken easily and then the celebrations begin. Bumrah comes back and gets a wicket. As simple as that. New Zealand in big trouble now. The bottom-hand came off after the inside edge is found.
